title: Review: Cell Voltage Protection Vertical Slice

revision_history.author: safety_engineer
revision_history.description: Initial review of vertical slice artifacts

scope: Complete cell voltage protection chain: hazard -> safety goal -> FSR -> TSR/HW/SW requirements -> design -> test measures -> execution

findings.description: FSR acquisition rate (10 Hz) not formally traced to FTTI budget allocation. Need timing analysis showing 100 ms period + 10 ms SOA check + 5 ms contactor = 115 ms < FTTI (100 ms) is violated.
findings.evidence: FSR-001 specifies 10 Hz (100 ms); FSR-002 specifies 10 ms check; FSR-003 specifies 5 ms contactor; sum = 115 ms > FTTI 100 ms

findings.description: Database publish latency (5 ms) not verified on target hardware. Host-based test execution does not guarantee target timing.
findings.evidence: Execution record shows actual_host_run on POSIX host

findings.description: AFE measurement accuracy (±1.5 mV) derived from datasheet, not verified on foxBMS hardware. No calibration procedure documented.
findings.evidence: Source is datasheet + driver config; no production test data

findings.description: SOA debounce count (3) not justified by statistical analysis. Arbitrary value may not optimize false positive/negative tradeoff.
findings.evidence: Config default is 3; no rationale in source

findings.description: Unit test uses mocked database and does not verify end-to-end timing from AFE acquisition to contactor opening.
findings.evidence: Test stimuli inject directly into SOA module, bypassing AFE driver and database

dispositions.action: Create timing budget analysis artifact; adjust FSR rates or FTTI in synthetic_reference
Add target timing verification as gap; synthetic_reference to include timing analysis
Mark as synthetic assumption in synthetic_reference; add calibration requirement
Add debounce rationale in synthetic_reference; link to statistical analysis
Add integration test requirement in synthetic_reference; as_is gap documented

limitations: AI-assisted review; not independent human review
Timing analysis not performed on target hardware
Hardware parameters from datasheets, not production measurements
Integration test coverage gap (unit tests only)
